title: The ordinary mate preserves the constant-module tensor comparison
statement: For geometric inverse-image data d and an ordinary adjoint identification o and normalized fixed tensor data t [def-sfb-constant-module-geometric-comparison-data], any strong monoidal structure m on d.pullR whose oplax tensorator is exactly d.ringTensor.mu satisfies TensorSquare with d.pullA, scalar restriction on J and K, their canonical ordinary monoidal structures [lem-sfb-constant-scalar-restriction-tensor], t.monoidal and o.left [def-sfb-derived-projection-comparison-squares]. This assertion concerns ordinary module sheaves only and constructs no derived structure.

proof.text: The adjoint Hom normalization of o.left identifies its inverse on underlying sheaves with the geometric insertion, followed by the scalar-extension unit. Identify the insertion defined by t.underlying.inv with this mate using t.hom; equality of the adjoint transposes gives equality of the maps.

lean.statement:
theorem constant_module_ordinary_tensor_square
    {C D : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Category.{v} D]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {A : Type (max u v)} [CommRing A]
    (d : GeometricData J K A) (o : OrdinaryIdentification d) (t : FixedTensorData d)
    (m : d.pullR.Monoidal)
    (hm : ∀ M N, @Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ _ _ _ _ _ _ d.pullR
      m.toOplaxMonoidal M N = (d.ringTensor.mu M N).hom) :
    TensorSquare d.pullR d.pullA (restriction J A) (restriction K A)
      m t.monoidal (restrictionBraided J A).toMonoidal
        (restrictionBraided K A).toMonoidal o.left
